name: Togakushi Shrine
description: A historic mountain-shrine complex at the foot of Mount Togakushi, visited for its five-shrine pilgrimage, sacred forest paths, and distinctive religious landscape.
highlights: A distinct mountain-culture anchor within Nagano City
